verdict.rationale: Adyen documents first-party APIs for parts of the risk workflow: the Disputes API (retrieve, defend or accept disputes), the Referrals API for automating block and trust lists, and risk data in webhooks and payment responses. However, core configuration such as overriding merchant risk settings and reviewing cases is described only as Customer Area UI actions, so full UI parity is not shown. Missing for 10: API evidence for configuring risk profiles, custom rules and risk settings, API-based case management review, and any explicit statement of API/UI parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can retrieve dispute information, defend or accept disputes, and upload defense documents.
You can use our Referrals API to automate uploading lists of referrals and referral details to block and trust lists.
You can include risk information, such as whether a payment was sent to case management, and which risk rules triggered in these webhooks, as well as in the payment response.
